why_seated: The distribution test — whether a documented heteronymic corpus converges at whole-corpus level or distributes work-by-work — requires the FULL RANGE of positions, since a null on a thin seat measures the seat. The prior seat carried four voices with Ricardo Reis at 5,548 tokens, which cannot fill a six-slot apparatus whatever Pessoa did. This seat carries 25 positions at 579,493 tokens, with Reis at 42,955 and Bernardo Soares — the Livro do Desassossego, absent entirely before — at 139,455.
ground_truth: The heteronymic attribution is DOCUMENTED, not inferred: the letter to Adolfo Casais Monteiro of 13 January 1935. This is the H-class positive control of EA-RELFORM-01 §3.
